name: B10-0424/2026 – § 14 – Am 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 14. Urges the Commission to ensure that no EU funds can reach or benefit, directly or indirectly, entities, partners, contractors, subcontractors, beneficial owners or final beneficiaries or recipients linked to Islamist networks, organisations promoting radicalisation, antisemitism or terrorism, or networks included on the EU list of terrorist organisations;
